bounds: One authorized autonomous disconnect with no remote manager, an initially authenticated or unauthenticated real CloudAuthService, and a synchronous host config save that succeeds or fails. Four model-generated terminal outcomes replay the real HTTP route, service registry, PGlite runtime, and filesystem save boundary.
limitations: This checks the added auth-service clearing call and config-key removal. It does not prove complete credential erasure across every host store, remote manager shutdown, authorization middleware, simultaneous login/disconnect, or pending provider request cancellation.
The save-failure outcome must remain a failure after local auth clearing. Recovery after that failure is outside this model; no successful persistent logout is claimed.
Progress assumes the authorized request is dispatched and its host writer returns. Safety does not require fairness.

assumptions: Weak fairness of clear, save, and reply; the authorized host invocation and synchronous filesystem save terminate. No provider or remote-manager responsiveness is assumed.
